Fifty Bar's Frozen Peach Lime Razz FIFTY BAR 20K MIDNIGHT SERIES is a grab-and-go disposable for adults. It is stocked at our Phoenix Stock Warehouse and shipped with tracking, so you can restock your favorite flavor without hunting around.

Frozen Peach Lime Razz FIFTY BAR 20K MIDNIGHT SERIES is listed at $16.99 in our Disposable Vapes range. Every product on the site is stocked for adults aged 21 and over, and you can browse the full [Disposable Vapes](/shop/disposables/) collection to compare it with similar options.

## Flavor and experience
The name Frozen Peach Lime Razz MIDNIGHT SERIES points to ripe berry sweetness that stays lively from first puff to last, with a sparkling citrus character that suits daytime vaping. Taste is subjective, and the same flavor can read sweeter or sharper depending on the device and your own palate, so use this as a starting point.

## Specifications
- **Brand:** Fifty Bar
- **Category:** Disposable Vapes
- **Flavor:** Frozen Peach Lime Razz MIDNIGHT SERIES
- **Nicotine strength:** 50mg (5%)
- **Price:** $16.99
- **Ships from:** Phoenix, Arizona Stock Warehouse
- **Age requirement:** 21+ with adult signature on delivery

## Key features and what they mean for you
- **Built-in battery:** removes the need for separate cells or chargers, which keeps the device compact enough for a pocket or bag.
- **Mesh-style coil technology:** helps spread heat evenly across the coil, which supports consistent flavor through the life of the device.
- **Large pre-filled capacity:** means fewer replacements and less packaging, which suits adults who vape through the day.
- **Single-purchase simplicity:** no pods to track, no coils to match, and no compatibility questions when you reorder.

### About the strength
This product is listed at 50mg (5%). Compare that figure with what you currently use before you order, remember that nicotine is addictive, and speak to a healthcare professional if you have questions about it.

## Who it suits
Frozen Peach Lime Razz FIFTY BAR 20K MIDNIGHT SERIES suits adult nicotine users who want a simple, ready-to-use device, travelers who prefer something that fits in a pocket, and anyone trying a new flavor before committing to a larger setup.

## Using and caring for it
Use the device only as directed on the packaging. Take gentle, short puffs rather than long, hard draws, which helps the coil keep up and avoids a burnt taste. Keep it upright when you are not using it, store it at room temperature away from direct sunlight and hot cars, and do not try to open, refill or modify it. When the flavor fades or the battery stops responding, dispose of it according to local rules for electronics and batteries. Keep it away from children and pets.

## Ordering, payment and delivery
Checkout accepts Cash App, Apple Pay, Chime, crypto and gift cards. Choosing crypto or a gift card takes 10% off your total, and orders of $200 or more after that discount ship free. A flat $15 fee applies to smaller orders, and the minimum order is $100.

Your parcel leaves our Phoenix Stock Warehouse within 24 to 72 business hours and ships with a tracking number. Adult signature (21+) is required on delivery, as federal PACT Act rules require for vapor products, so please plan to be available or choose an address where an adult can sign.

## Returns and support
If something is wrong with your order, contact us within 30 days and we will help. Unopened items in original packaging can be returned or exchanged, a 15% restocking fee applies to refunds, and refunds go back through the payment method you originally used. Opened or used e-liquid and devices cannot be returned. Our refund policy has the full details. Read the full [refund policy](/refunds/) and [shipping policy](/shipping/), or visit the [FAQ](/faq/) for more answers.
